dossier.scp_unleashed.111.title: Dragon-Snails
dossier.scp_unleashed.111.caption: SCP-111-3 at intake, beside its packaging and a clutch of ova.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-111 instances are housed in a terrarium of fired clay and stone. No straw, timber or paper is to be kept inside. Fresh greens are provided daily. **Instances are never to be struck, prodded or handled roughly.**
Unhatched ova are kept in storage containers fitted with a Cold Storage Upgrade. Staff moving ova are to tread carefully; the ova are small and easily crushed underfoot.
Escaped instances are recovered with greens as bait. Fire extinguishers are to be kept in the containment wing at all times.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-111 is a population of small gastropods, each a little over a third of a metre long, bearing the head of a miniature dragon. Eight colourations are known, each with its own shell: spiral, banded, conical, domed, spiked, ringed, turreted and crystalline.
Instances glide slowly and graze on plant matter left on the ground: leaves, root vegetables, grain, seeds and berries. Hungry instances have been seen chewing at hedges.
Instances are docile, but every one of them breathes fire. Small puffs of flame escape them at intervals. Anything that strikes an instance receives a short, hot jet of flame in reply.
Well-fed instances lay small clutches of ova as they wander. Hatchlings are fully formed and grow quickly.

page.title: Addendum 111-1: Test Log
text: Test 111-04: an instance was tapped with a pointer. It turned and set the pointer alight. %rThe researcher was unharmed.%r
Test 111-07: an instance offered only stone and scrap metal ignored both. It laid nothing until it was fed.
Test 111-09: a shelf of ova was left overnight in a storage container whose cold unit had been removed for servicing. %rThe laboratory was evacuated the following morning.%r

page.title: Addendum 111-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-111 has no recovery record. A box of twenty-four ova was delivered to a reader of this file by the individual in the striped ringmaster's coat and top hat described in the file on SCP-018. The box is printed with the slogan "Dr. Wondertainment's Dragon-Snails! Collect all eight!" and a warning that its contents may hatch. %rNo return address was found.%r See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_egg.1: Dragon-snail eggs come in %s colours. A clutch always matches the snail that laid it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_egg.2: Set them down on solid ground and, given time, they hatch. Careless feet will crack them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_egg.3: Eggs that are picked up remember how far along they were.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_egg.4: A storage container shelves up to %s eggs, and a tall one holds %s on two shelves.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_box.1: Dr. Wondertainment's Dragon-Snails! A collector's box of %s eggs in eight delightful colours.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_box.2: Use it to unbox the eggs. The box itself fits in a storage container.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_box.3: Delivered free of charge to readers of a certain archive file.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp111_snail_spaw: SCP-111, the Dragon-Snails: tiny snails with little dragon heads. %s health.
They glide about slowly, graze on greens left lying on the ground and now and then lay a clutch of eggs.
They are not hostile. Anything that strikes one gets a short burst of flame in reply.
They do not occur naturally; their archive file has more on where they come from.
